content_zh: 大中华区员工出差应优先选择公司协议酒店。标准城市住宿上限为每晚 1200 人民币（含税），超标需走例外审批。
content_en: Employees in Greater China should prioritize contracted hotels. Standard-city accommodation cap is CNY 1200 per night (tax included); exceptions require approval.

title_zh: 酒店 Sourcing 申请流程
content_zh: 在内部差旅系统提交酒店 Sourcing 工单，填写目的地、入住日期、预算与入住天数。Travel Team 在 1 个工作日内反馈方案。
content_en: Submit a hotel sourcing ticket in the internal travel system with destination, check-in date, budget, and stay length. Travel Team responds within 1 business day.

content_zh: 差旅报销须在出差结束后 30 天内提交，需附电子发票与行程单。超过时限需直属经理审批说明。
content_en: Travel reimbursements must be submitted within 30 days after trip completion with e-invoices and itinerary proof. Late submissions require manager approval.

content_zh: Travel Team 邮箱：travel-support@company.com；办公时间 09:00-18:00（北京时间）。紧急问题请在邮件标题标注 [URGENT]。
content_en: Travel Team email: travel-support@company.com; office hours 09:00-18:00 (Beijing time). For urgent issues, add [URGENT] in subject.

content_zh: 签证支持申请请至少提前 15 个自然日提交，需提供护照首页、出差邀请函和行程计划。咨询邮箱：visa-support@company.com。
content_en: Submit visa support requests at least 15 calendar days in advance with passport front page, invitation letter, and itinerary. Contact: visa-support@company.com.

content_zh: 上海协议酒店示例：Hotel A（协议价 850 RMB/晚），Hotel B（协议价 980 RMB/晚）。具体可订状态以预订系统实时信息为准。
content_en: Contracted hotels in Shanghai (sample): Hotel A (CNY 850/night), Hotel B (CNY 980/night). Availability depends on real-time booking system status.
